name: Global Error Router - Telegram DLQ Template

parameters.content:
# 🚨 Global Error Router
Automatically handles failed workflows.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Saves failures to DLQ JSONL file
• Sends Telegram alerts
• Includes execution URL
• Captures response body excerpts
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REQUIRED ENV VARS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

TELEGRAM_ERROR_CHAT_ID
or
TELEGRAM_APPROVAL_CHAT_ID

PUBLIC_N8N_BASE_URL
or
N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OPTIONAL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
N8N_ERROR_DLQ_PATH
Default:
/files/dlq/n8n-errors.jsonl
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SETUP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Import workflow
2. Activate workflow
3. Open production workflow
4. Settings → Error Workflow
5. Select:
   Global Error Router
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TEST
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Use a Code node:
throw new Error('Test failure');
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMPORTANT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠ Do NOT run this workflow manually
This workflow only works when
triggered from another failed workflow.
